system.name: Hydro
system.one_liner: a surrogate-based hyperparameter tuning service that shrinks and fuses trials into cheap surrogate models while allocating datacenter resources efficiently

components.name: User Config
components.role: developer-provided search space and target model definitions that start a tuning job

components.name: Search Space
components.role: the hyperparameter search space defined by the developer

components.name: Target Model
components.role: the model the developer wants to tune

components.name: Hydro Tuner
components.role: user interface that automatically generates and optimizes surrogate models and tuning trials

components.name: Model Shrinker
components.role: shrinks the target model into a surrogate via symbolic trace and parametrization

components.name: Symbolic Trace
components.role: traces the model program symbolically to enable transformation

components.name: Parametrization
components.role: parametrizes the model to build a scalable surrogate

components.name: Trial Binder
components.role: fuses multiple tuning trials together to reduce overhead

components.name: Inter-Trial Fusion
components.role: fuses independent trials together

components.name: Intra-Trial Fusion
components.role: fuses stages within a single trial together

components.name: Surrogate Model
components.role: the generated smaller model used to approximate full tuning trials

components.name: Trial Profiler
components.role: profiles trials to inform the surrogate model and trial planning

components.name: Trial Planner
components.role: orchestrates trial execution using adaptive fusion and eager transfer

components.name: Adaptive Fusion
components.role: adaptively decides how trials are fused during planning

components.name: Eager Transfer
components.role: eagerly transfers state/results to speed up planning

components.name: Hydro Coordinator
components.role: improves tuning efficiency and datacenter-level resource utilization

components.name: Bubble Squeezer
components.role: extends tuning workload resources by interleaving training with a pipeline-enabled large model

components.name: Heterogeneity-Aware Allocator
components.role: improves resource utilization and cluster-wide performance by allocating proper accelerators on different tuning stages

components.name: Cluster Scheduler
components.role: central scheduler connecting the coordinator's other modules (its detailed role is not covered by the excerpted text)

components.name: Elastic Executor
components.role: dynamically executes trials by splitting fused trials and enabling distributed training

components.name: Dynamic Split
components.role: splits fused trials back apart dynamically at execution time

components.name: Distributed Training
components.role: enables distributed training of split trials

components.name: Execution Backend
components.role: underlying execution engines Hydro dispatches tuning trials to

components.name: RAY
components.role: execution backend used to run tuning trials

components.name: PyTorch
components.role: execution backend used to run tuning trials

flows.what: search space and target model, invoked via Hydro APIs
surrogate and profiling information exchanged bidirectionally
profiling results used to plan trial execution
optimized tuning trials handed off for resource allocation

content.key_idea: Hydro splits into a Tuner that shrinks and fuses trials into cheap surrogate models to plan tuning, and a Coordinator that allocates heterogeneous cluster resources and elastically executes the resulting trials on Ray/PyTorch.
content.reading_order: Top-down through three numbered stages: Job Creation from User Config into the blue Hydro Tuner, Resource Allocation in the purple Hydro Coordinator, and Tuning Execution on the backend at the bottom.

evidence: Figure 4 depicts the architecture of the Hydro service. It consists of two key system components
Hydro Coordinator also includes three modules: Bubble Squeezer...Heterogeneity-Aware Allocator...Elastic Executor
The system workflow of Hydro is presented by black arrows in Figure 4

summary: This figure shows Hydro's architecture and workflow for surrogate-based hyperparameter tuning. A developer's User Config (search space, target model) enters the blue Hydro Tuner block at step 1 (Job Creation), where a Model Shrinker (symbolic trace, parametrization) and Trial Binder (inter- and intra-trial fusion) produce a Surrogate Model that exchanges information with a Trial Profiler, feeding a Trial Planner (adaptive fusion, eager transfer). At step 2 (Resource Allocation), the purple Hydro Coordinator block takes over, with a Bubble Squeezer and Heterogeneity-Aware Allocator feeding a central Cluster Scheduler that drives an Elastic Executor (dynamic split, distributed training). At step 3 (Tuning Execution), trials run on the Ray or PyTorch execution backend. Three circled numbers mark the stages, and orange sub-module boxes sit inside the two color-coded blocks.
summary_zh: Hydro 架构：用户配置进入蓝色 Tuner（模型收缩、试验绑定与规划生成代理模型），紫色 Coordinator 分配资源并调度弹性执行，试验最终在 Ray/PyTorch 上执行。
